scenario: Harbor Metals filed its complete NOI on March 1. Its new outfall began discharging industrial stormwater on March 12.
policy: A discharge of stormwater associated with industrial activity requires coverage under an NPDES permit. Coverage is obtained by filing a Notice of Intent (NOI) at least 30 days before the discharge begins. Discharges that begin before the 30-day waiting period elapses are unpermitted.
question: Was Harbor Metals' March 12 discharge permitted?
